name: Kunstnernes Hus
known: An artist-founded house whose Council seats eight Norwegian artists' associations, with Norske Billedkunstnere in the chair; its own pages name no parent institution.

name: MUNCH
known: Tone Hansen is director (INPEX, 2023).

name: Nasjonalmuseet (National Museum of Norway)
known: It also says the first director, Sune Nordgren, resigned in 2006 after a long period of professional criticism and staff conflicts.
The director is Ingrid Røynesdal, appointed in 2023, after Karin Hindsbo (2017 to 2023) (Wikipedia).

name: UKS (Unge Kunstneres Samfund / Young Artists' Society)
known: Founded by artists in 1921.
Exhibitions are chosen by working artists on the board and the director, with the programme drawn from an annual open call (UKS website).
Governed by a chair and six board members elected for two-year terms by the annual general assembly.
The current chair is Ragnhild Aamås (UKS website).

name: Vigeland Museum
known: The museum's senior curator Tone Wikborg is quoted as saying this does not make him a sympathiser of any political system (English Wikipedia, citing Slagstad 2008, Gauguin 1945 and Wikborg 2019; the originals were not read).

name: Kunsthall Stavanger
known: Founded in 1865 as Stavanger kunstforening (Stavanger Art Association) by a group of citizens, with 62 original members and the consul and amateur artist Jens Zetlitz Kielland as first chairman.
Director: Joseph Constable.
Stavanger kommune has a representative on the board, and the chair for 2024 to 2025 is Martha Norheim Lyse.

name: Nordnorsk Kunstmuseum
known: Frode Haverkamp was appointed first director in autumn 1986, and the museum opened to the public in February 1988 in rented rooms above the Tromsø Artist's Union at Muségata 2 (museum history page).
On 30 March 2020 the board removed director Jérémie McGowan, in post since 2016, without giving a reason.

On 1 April three artist board members, Joar Nango, Inger Blix Kvammen and Trygve Luktvasslimo, resigned, writing that the matter had been handled in a very poor way (NRK, "First the museum director was fired, now parts of the board are resigning in protest", 1 April 2020, title translated).
Director Katya García-Antón said museums should ideally be fully state-funded and called corporate and private sponsorship in Norway "at an early stage" (Kunstkritikk, 30 November 2022).

name: Bait Al Zubair
known: The Zubair Corporation, founded in 1967 as Muscat Trading Company by Mohammad Al Zubair after he left Petroleum Development Oman, was renamed in 1973; it ranked 32nd on Forbes Middle East's 2022 list of Arab family businesses, chaired by Rashad Mohammad Al Zubair.

name: National Museum of Oman
known: Oman adopted an austerity budget for 2016, and acting director general Jamal al Moosawi said it "poses challenges when it comes to managing and operating the institution" (The Art Newspaper, 2016).
Its Board of Trustees is chaired by the Minister of Heritage and Tourism, Salim bin Mohammed al-Mahrouqi, as of its meeting on 13 March 2025 (Times of Oman).
The board page still names Sayyid Ibrahim bin Saeed Al Busaidi as chair and Minister, so its list is out of date.

name: Karachi Biennale Trust
known: Niilofur Farrukh is listed as co-founder and was CEO through 2025 (the Trust's founders page).
The first edition, KB17, was curated by trustee Amin Gulgee.
KB22 focused on art and technology, curated by Faisal Anwar, for Pakistan's 75th anniversary (APP).
Ten trustees are listed, led by Shanaz Ramzi (Managing Trustee) and Atteqa Malik (Chairperson).

name: Mohatta Palace Museum
known: Nasreen Askari has been the museum's curator since 1998.

name: Vasl Artists' Association
known: Adeela Suleman, now Executive Director, has been a volunteer since 2002 and is listed as a founding member.

name: Lahore Biennale Foundation
known: Rahim is co-founder and executive director.
Naazish Ata-Ullah and Raza Ali Dada are co-chairs of the board (lahorebiennale.org).
LB02, early 2020, curated by Hoor Al Qasimi.
LB03 "Of Mountains and Seas", 5 October to 8 November 2024, curated by John Tain.
LB04 is slated for early 2027, curated by Nav Haq (Biennial Foundation).
Rashid Rana, named artistic director of the first biennale in 2016, stepped down in September 2017.

name: Dar Jacir for Art and Research
known: Founded in 2014 by Emily Jacir, with Annemarie Jacir and Yusuf Nasri Jacir listed as co-founders.
Named for Yusuf Nasri Jacir, whom Wikipedia lists as a co-founder.

name: The Palestinian Museum
known: Directors: Jack Persekian until his resignation in December 2015, Mahmoud Hawari from 2016, Adila Laidi-Hanieh from 2018 to 2023, and Amer Shomali as General Director from October 2023 (Wikipedia;
In 2022 the Aliph Foundation gave 480,000 US dollars for a textile conservation studio at the museum, with the Victoria and Albert Museum (Hyperallergic, Valentina Di Liscia, 13 March 2022;
Omar Al-Qattan, chairman of the A.
Qattan Foundation, led the museum as board chairman and acting director in 2016 (The Art Newspaper;
It posts annual reports for 2020 to 2022, a named founding-donor list and eleven board directors.
